6.d: Keskaelise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Juuksed ja põskahbe hallikas, ülikond ja ristlips tumedad.
6.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in three-quarter profile facing right. Hair and side-whiskers greyish, suit and cross tie dark.

27.d: Keskealise mehe rinnapilt, peapöördega poolprofiilis paremale. Üle musta jaki rinnaesise lai punane valgete triipudega ordenipael.
27.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man, head turned in semi-profile to the right. Over a black jacket a wide red order ribbon with white stripes across the chest.

29.d: Esiplaanil keskel viigipuu all puuoksast vasaku käega kinnihoidva noore tõmmu naise kuju, kellel peakatteks punane rätt. Keskosas kõrgemal mäenõlval üle puude ja nende vahelt paistev esinduslik kivihoone. Tagaplaanil kõrged hallid kaljud.
29.de: In the foreground in the middle, under a fig tree, the figure of a young dark-haired woman holding onto a branch of the tree with her left hand, wearing a red headscarf. In the central part, higher on the mountain slope, a stately stone building visible over and between the trees. In the background high grey cliffs.

33.d: Esiplaani künklik maastik, mille keskosas põõsaid ja puusalu, areneb tagaplaanil paremal kaugelt paistvaks mäeahelikuks. Ees vasakul tahutud kivilahmakaid. Tõusva päikese laialipaiskuv kiirtevihk katkeb vasakul etteulatuva halli pilverünka tõttu.
33.de: A hilly landscape in the foreground, with bushes and a grove of trees in the middle section, developing into a distant mountain range visible on the right in the background. In front on the left, hewn boulders. The spreading beam of the rising sun's rays is interrupted on the left by a jutting grey cloud mass.

37.d: Esiplaanil paremal oja, vana vesiratas ja rippuvate okstega puu. Taga lagunenud hoone. Vasakul kaljud.
37.de: In the foreground on the right a stream, an old water wheel and a tree with hanging branches. Behind, a dilapidated building. On the left, cliffs.

40.d: Interjöör muusikastseeniga. Paremal äärel külgvaates pianiino, mille ees istuv triibulises kleidis daam jälgib oma klaverimängu mõju vasakul, punases tugitoolis istuvale tumedajuukselisele tütarlapsele.
40.de: An interior with a music scene. On the right edge, seen from the side, a piano, in front of which a lady in a striped dress sits, observing the effect of her piano playing on a dark-haired girl sitting on the left in a red armchair.

44.dm: kõrgus: 156.0 cm; sügavus: 69.0 cm; laius: 73.5 cm
44.d: Pikajuukselise habemega mehe istuv figuur pikas rüüs, kannel vasakus käes, parem käsi üles tõstetud, süle katab karunahk, kandle keeled nööridest, kipsiga kaetud.
44.de: Sitting figure of a long-haired, bearded man in a long robe, kantele in left hand, right hand raised, lap covered with a bearskin, kantele strings made of cords, covered with plaster.

49.dm: kõrgus: 30.0 cm; sügavus: 9.5 cm; laius: 9.0 cm
49.d: Mehe akt seisvas asendis, niudevöö, pea kallutatud ette, parem käsi küljel.
49.de: A male nude in standing position, loincloth, head tilted forward, right hand at the side.

1874.dm: laius: 51.0 cm; kõrgus: 54.0 cm (vm, alusraamita); kõrgus: 58.2 cm; laius: 44.0 cm (vm, alusraamita)
1874.d: Esiplaanil tasane niit, keskel paremal kõrvuti kase ja kuuse tüvi, millest viimase oksastik piirab pildi ülaosa kuni vasaku ääreni. Tagaplaanil jätkub lilledega puisniit päikesepaistel.
1874.de: In the foreground a flat meadow, in the middle right side by side a birch and spruce trunk, the branches of the latter bordering the upper part of the picture up to the left edge. In the background a flowering wooded meadow continues in sunshine.

1875.d: All ees tüvelt murdunud puu, vasakul kasvav lehtpuu.
1875.de: Below in front a tree broken at the trunk, on the left a growing deciduous tree.

1945.dm: lehe laius: 15.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 21.6 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 11.7 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 15.0 cm

1951.dm: lehe laius: 7.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 8.8 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 10.0 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 12.7 cm
1951.d: Pikajuukselise, lõughabemega, kahe käega suu juures piipu hoidva vana talupoja pikk-kuues poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule.
1951.de: Half-figure of an old peasant with long hair and a chin beard, holding a pipe to his mouth with both hands, wearing a long coat, in a slight turn to the left.

1962.d: Keskel teel eemalduv ühehobuse vanker, millel istub mees piitsaga käes. Vankril puunõu. Vankri kõrval vasakul lehm. Tagapool horisondil mets, mille ees paremal sõiduk, kooguga kaev, küün ja üksik puu.
1962.de: In the middle of the road, a receding one-horse cart on which a man sits holding a whip. A wooden vessel on the cart. Beside the cart on the left a cow. Further back on the horizon a forest, in front of which on the right a vehicle, a well with a sweep, a barn and a solitary tree.

1965.dm: graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 9.5 cm; lehe laius: 10.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 13.3 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 11.8 cm
1965.d: Interjööris kaks laua ääres istuvat talumeest, paremal nende kõrvel seisev, mõtliku ilmega talumees, hoidmas piipu. Kõigil seljas pikk-kuued.
1965.de: In the interior two peasant men sitting at a table, on the right beside them a peasant man with a thoughtful expression standing, holding a pipe. All are wearing long coats.

6744.d: Ees paremal pajupõõsas. Selle taga vasakult paremale suunduv lattaed. Tahapoole kerkiva künka tagant näha taluhoone õlgkatust. Taamal üle puulatvade vaade merele.
6744.de: In the foreground on the right a willow bush. Behind it a plank fence running from left to right. Behind the rising hill the straw roof of a farm building is visible. In the distance a view of the sea over the treetops.

6764.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaljune rand vähese vegetatsiooniga, paremal meri, lahesopis luigleva purjekaga. Taamal paremal paistavad üle lahe kaljud ja mäeharjad.
6764.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky shore with sparse vegetation, on the right the sea, in the bay a sailboat gliding like a swan. In the distance on the right, cliffs and mountain ridges are visible across the bay.

7231.d: Paremal käredavooluline jõgi veskitammiga, vasemal kaks suurt puud ja üksik figuur teerajal. Tagapool õlgkatusega hooned. Kauguses mets ja pruunikas toonis kõrgustiku siluett.
7231.de: On the right a fast-flowing river with a mill dam, on the left two large trees and a solitary figure on a path. Behind, buildings with straw roofs. In the distance a forest and, in brownish tones, the silhouette of a highland.

7307.d: Toolil istuva noore naise figuur, laps (jeesus) süles, taga paremal teine poisikene (Johannes).
7307.de: Figure of a young woman seated on a chair, a child (Jesus) in her lap, behind on the right another boy (John).

7313.d: Vasakul noore, punasesse riietatud, tumedajuukselise naise süles lapsuke valges särgis, pilk suunatud ema näole. Paremal kollakat tooni rõivastuses helefajuukseline, ümber pea keeratud patssoenguga noor naine langetatud pilgul last silmitsemas. Paremas käes palmioks. Taustaks mägimaastik.
7313.de: On the left, in the lap of a young dark-haired woman dressed in red, a small child in a white shirt, its gaze directed at the mother's face. On the right, a young woman with light hair braided and wound around her head, wearing yellowish clothing, looking down at the child. In her right hand a palm branch. Background a mountain landscape.

7345.d: Keskel esiplaanil munk mustas mantlis taga müür gooti värava arkaadiga. Müüri nurk vasakul lõpeb ümartorniga. Õues paremal vaate ja tünne.
7345.de: In the centre foreground a monk in a black cloak, behind him a wall with a Gothic gate arcade. The corner of the wall on the left ends in a round tower. In the yard on the right a vat and barrels.

7346.d: Interjöör punases sametkleidis seisva naisfiguuriga paremal, vasemal tool vaibaga, ees põrandal tapetud linnud.
7346.de: Interior with a female figure standing in a red velvet dress on the right, on the left a chair with a rug, in front on the floor dead birds.

7715.d: Ees ja vasakul kivine, lage rand haokubu kandva vanamehe ja väikese lapsega. Taamal, silmapiiril, vastaskaldal linnavaade.
7715.de: In the front and on the left a stony, bare shore with an old man carrying a bundle of brushwood and a small child. In the distance, on the horizon, a townscape on the opposite bank.

7716.d: Esiplaanil liivane rand, kaks kaldale tõmmatud paati ja paremal paljajalu paatide suunas sammuv mehefiguur, kandam seljas; taga avameri.
7716.de: In the foreground a sandy shore, two boats pulled up onto the shore, and on the right a barefoot male figure walking towards the boats, a burden on his back; behind, the open sea.

7739.d: Lumme mattunud surnuaia vaade: esiplaanil vasakul kaks lumist risti ja raagus puud. Paremal servas, sepisaiaga piiratud hauaplatsil üks suurem rist. Madalat silmapiiri jumestab loojuva päikese puna. Ülalpool taevas hall.
7739.de: A view of a snow-covered cemetery: in the foreground on the left two snowy crosses and bare trees. On the right edge, on a grave plot enclosed by a wrought-iron fence, one larger cross. The low horizon is tinged with the red of the setting sun. Above, the sky is grey.

7845.d: Tumedajuukselise poisikeseohtu noormehe rinnapilt, käsipõsakil nõjatuvana paremale küünarnukile. Peas lai, madal kübar, seljas tume metallnööpidega kuub ja valge särk punase kaelarätikuga. Vasakul äärel viinamarjaväät. Kujutis ovaalis.
7845.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired boyish young man, leaning on his right elbow with his cheek resting on his hand. On his head a wide, low hat, wearing a dark coat with metal buttons and a white shirt with a red neckerchief. On the left edge a vine garland. The image is in an oval.

7951.d: Esiplaanil vasakul palgiparved vees, keskel ja paremal rand purjeka ja paatidega, taga kõrgel kaldas valge hoone.
7951.de: In the foreground on the left log rafts in the water, in the middle and on the right a beach with a sailboat and boats, behind on a high bank a white building.

7953.d: Vasakul kitsas, kivine, kaugemal kaljuseinaks muutuv rannariba. Paremal meri purjekatega ranna läheduses ja kaks paati sõudjatega. Kaks kolmandikku maalist kaetud rünkpilvituses taevaga.
7953.de: On the left a narrow, stony strip of shore that further away turns into a rock face. On the right the sea with sailboats near the shore and two boats with rowers. Two thirds of the painting is covered with a sky full of cumulus clouds.

8173.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud hauakünkal suur raudrist BEHREND von MAIDELLi nimega. Tagapool puude vahel näha üksikuid riste.
8173.de: In the foreground a large iron cross with the name BEHREND von MAIDELL on a grassy grave mound. Behind, individual crosses visible among the trees.

8218.d: Mere kaldal paremal kõrge kivirist, selle vastu toetub noor naine punases pihikus ja triibulises seelikus. Naise kõrval paremal väike tüdruk, paremal istuv koer. Vasakul vaade lainetavale merele, mille kohal lendlemas kajakaid.
8218.de: On the shore of the sea, on the right a tall stone cross, against which a young woman in a red bodice and striped skirt leans. Beside the woman on the right a little girl, on the right a sitting dog. On the left a view of the undulating sea, above which gulls are flying.

8219.d: Esiplaanil paremal tugitool linnuga käsipuul. Vasemal gloobus, kaste. Kõrval kapinurk, millel mitmesuguseid esemeid (kann, kolp). Tumedal seinal suur punase paelaga seotud bukett.
8219.de: In the foreground on the right an armchair with a bird on the armrest. On the left a globe, a box. Beside it the corner of a cabinet with various objects on it (a jug, a skull). On the dark wall a large bouquet tied with a red ribbon.

8233.d: Noore tütarlapse rinnapilt: õlad külgvaates, pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Lahtsitel juustel turbanitaoliselt seotud rätik.
8233.de: Bust portrait of a young girl: shoulders in side view, head in three-quarter profile to the left. A kerchief tied turban-like over loose hair.

8245.d: Vasakul kuust valgustatud jõgi. Kaugemal üksik sõudja. Paremal madalal kaldal üksikute jändrikute puude vahel madal taluhoone.
8245.de: On the left a moonlit river. In the distance a lone rower. On the right on a low bank, among a few gnarled trees, a low farmhouse.

8254.d: Esiplaanil kõrkjatega läbikasvanud veekogu. Taga vasemal madal rohumaa üksikute puudega; paremal madala taluhoone ja lehtpuudega.
8254.de: In the foreground a body of water overgrown with sedge. Behind on the left low grassland with solitary trees; on the right a low farm building and deciduous trees.

8267.d: Keskel liivane metsatee, vasemal mets, paremal tee ääres üksikud puud, tagapool mets.
8267.de: In the middle a sandy forest path, on the left forest, on the right by the road solitary trees, forest behind.

8355.d: Vaade avarale merele: esiplaanil vasakul merest väljakasvanud kaljud kahe stafaažse figuuriga kaljudel istumas. Paremas kuni silmapiirini helesinine meri üksiku purjepaadiga. Ülal silmapiiri kohal kollane, kõrgemal tuhmsinine taevas.
8355.de: View of an open sea: in the foreground on the left, cliffs rising out of the sea with two staffage figures sitting on them. On the right, a light blue sea reaching to the horizon with a lone sailing boat. Above the horizon, yellow, and higher up a dull blue sky.

8419.d: Esiplaanil paremal puu, vasakul palkide virn. Keskplaanil paremal veekogu, millel siinpool kaldal palgid, sellest vasakul maas lebavate palkide taga kiviaed, mille keskkoht lagunenud. Kiviaia taga lehtpuud. Tagaplaanil kõrged mäed.
8419.de: In the foreground on the right, a tree, on the left a stack of logs. In the middle ground on the right, a body of water, with logs on the near shore, to the left of which, behind logs lying on the ground, a stone wall whose middle part is dilapidated. Behind the stone wall, deciduous trees. In the background, high mountains.

8420.d: Esiplaanil habemega mees punases rüüs suuldeb Kristust punase mantlis. Temast paremal tagapool kolm inimfiguuri, vasakul kaks sõjameest, kellest esimene hoiab paremas käes tõrvikut.
8420.de: In the foreground a bearded man in a red robe accuses Christ, who is in a red cloak. To his right, further back, three human figures, on the left two soldiers, the first of whom holds a torch in his right hand.

8481.d: Tütarlapse põlvpilt istuvas asendis pöördega vasakule. Põlvedel lahtine raamat.
8481.de: Knee-length portrait of a girl seated, turned to the left. An open book on her knees.

8528.dm: kõrgus: 47.7 cm (ovaalne kujutis); laius: 42.3 cm (ovaalne kujutis)
8528.d: Väikese tüdruku rinnapilt kerge pöördega paremale. Otselahuga shatäänid juuksed lahtiselt seljale rippumas. Seljas punane pluus rohekat tooni kaelusega, millest paistab valge särgi kaelus.
8528.de: Bust portrait of a little girl with a slight turn to the right. Straight-parted chestnut-brown hair hanging loose down her back. Wearing a red blouse with a greenish-toned collar, from under which a white shirt collar shows.

8703.d: Ees mahalangenud okaspuid, taga vasemal kaks küüni. Tagaplaanil segamets.
8703.de: In front fallen conifer trees, behind on the left two barns. In the background a mixed forest.

8776.d: Esiplaanil keskel pika kuuega mees ema järel lehma tirimas, temast vasakul tahapoole suunduv vanker kahe figuuriga, kellest üks tagantvaates. Vankri kõrval vasakul lehm. Maali esiplaanil paremal varjualune mitme figuuriga laua ümber. Tagaplaanil hulk inimesi, vankreid ja hobuseid.(eesti)
8776.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a man in a long coat pulling a cow after his mother; to his left a cart heading backward with two figures, one seen from behind. Beside the cart on the left a cow. In the foreground on the right of the painting a shelter with several figures around a table. In the background a number of people, carts and horses.

8780.d: Paremalt alt hargnev lehtpuu oksastik lopsakate lehtedega. Okste vahel suurelehelisi viinamarjavääte. Lõuendi vasakpoolne alumine nurk 26 x 8,5 cm ulatuses värviga katmata krunt.
8780.de: A branch of a deciduous tree with lush leaves, branching from the lower right. Between the branches large-leaved grapevine tendrils. The lower left corner of the canvas has an area of 26 x 8.5 cm of unpainted ground.

8781.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 30.5 cm; lehe laius: 27.9 cm
8781.d: Kuust valgustatud lainetav meri. Ees vasakul kaljul istuv pikkade õlgadele langevate juustega vanamees selgvaates. Paremal lainete kohal kaks hoogsalt ettepoole liikuvat nägemuslikku figuuri.
8781.de: A moonlit, undulating sea. In front, on the left, on a cliff, an old man seen from the back, with long hair falling to his shoulders. On the right, above the waves, two visionary figures moving briskly forward.

8855.d: Mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis, pea pöördega vasakule, keha paremale. Tumesinises kuues, valge kaelasideme ja ordeniga.
8855.de: Bust portrait of a man, in half-profile, head turned to the left, body to the right. In a dark blue coat, with a white cravat and an order.

8973.d: Kaljune mererand istuva naise ja poisi figuuridega esiplaanil vasakul. Vaiksel merel paremal üksik purjepaat. Taevas kergelt pilves.
8973.de: A rocky sea shore with the figures of a seated woman and a boy in the foreground on the left. On the calm sea on the right a lone sailing boat. The sky slightly clouded.

9023.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides maalitud mererand: esiplaanil rohututid, kaldale tõmmatud ja vaia külge kinnitatud paat (valges tanus naine paadis külitamas) ja postidel kuivavad mõrrad. Esiplaanil keskel pruunis seelikus, mustas jakis, valges tanus ja põlles naine, kalakorv kaenla all. Foonil silmapiirini ulatuv tüüne meri üksikute paatidega ja sinine, ülalt heledasti valgustatud pilvedega taevas.
9023.de: A sea shore painted in grey and brown tones: in the foreground grass tufts, a boat drawn up onto the shore and fastened to a stake (a woman in a white bonnet lying sideways in the boat) and fish traps drying on posts. In the foreground centre a woman in a brown skirt, black jacket, white bonnet and apron, a fish basket under her arm. In the background a calm sea reaching to the horizon with a few boats, and a blue sky brightly lit from above with clouds.

9032.d: Esiplaanil mererand. Keskel neli meest noota harutamas. Läbi vee läheneb rannale kalur. Merel näha paati.
9032.de: A seashore in the foreground. In the middle four men untangling a fishing net. A fisherman approaching the shore through the water. A boat visible at sea.

9267.d: Kaks suurt haralist puud, mille võred katavad suure osa maalist, nii et vasakule jääb väike osa madala silmapiiriga pilves taevast. Samas kitsas riba veekogu (teisel see puudub). Puude vahel ja vee kaldal lehmad. Erinevus teisega veel selles, et puudub veel figuur.
9267.de: Two large branching trees, whose crowns cover a large part of the painting, so that a small part of a cloudy sky with a low horizon remains on the left. In the same place a narrow strip of water (absent in the second one). Between the trees and on the water's edge cows. Another difference from the second one is the absence of a figure.

9269.d: Tumedajuukselise poisikese poolakt profiilis vasakule. Foon punakaspruun.
9269.de: Half-nude of a dark-haired boy in profile to the left. Background reddish-brown.

9289.d: Keskelt lahku kammitud juustega tumedapäise habemiku mehe rinnapilt en face. Pea kallutatud alla.
9289.de: Bust portrait en face of a dark-haired bearded man with hair combed apart in the middle. Head tilted down.

9460.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, pildi äärel kuni silmapiirini ulatuv meri, millest keskel, kalda läheduses, ulatub välja kaljutippe; paremal kivine rannariba, mille läheduses suurem lehtpuu. Puu otsas karusnahkse mütsi ja põhitoonis punase särgiga noormees puu ümber põimunud viinamarja väätidelt korjatud kobaraid korviga alla laskmas; korvile vastu sirutuva puu all oleva heledapäise lapse käed. Läheduses noor, punast pihikuga seelikut ja valget pluusi kandev pikkade, seljal lahtiselt rippuvate juustega naine puu küljest allarippuvat viinamarjavääti haaramas. Keskel, vasakule mere poole kalduv mäeveerg lopsaka taimestikuga, mille hulgas palju küpresse. Taga paremal pildi ülemisest äärest välja ulatuv kal
9460.de: In the foreground on the left, at the edge of the picture, the sea extends to the horizon; in the middle of it, near the shore, rocky peaks rise up; on the right a rocky strip of shore, near which stands a larger deciduous tree. At the top of the tree, a young man in a fur cap and a shirt predominantly red in tone is lowering a basket down with bunches of grapes gathered from the vine tendrils twined around the tree; below, a fair-haired child under the tree stretches out its hands toward the basket. Nearby, a young woman with a red bodice and skirt and a white blouse, with long hair hanging loose over her back, is grasping a vine tendril hanging down from the tree. In the middle, a mountain slope sloping to the left toward the sea, with lush vegetation, among which many cypresses. Further back on the right, a cl[iff] extending beyond the upper edge of the picture

9468.dm: lehe kõrgus: 39.5 cm; lehe laius: 58.8 cm
9468.d: Ees meri kivise kaldaribaga. Merel sõudepaadid ja purjekas. Kaugemal merest kerkiv koonusekujuline, tipust suitsu välja ajav mägi.
9468.de: In the foreground the sea with a rocky shoreline strip. Rowing boats and a sailboat on the sea. Farther away a cone-shaped mountain rising from the sea, emitting smoke from its top.

9484.d: Noore ruugejuukselise naise rinnapilt otsevaates. Kõrvu vabaks jättev soeng otselahuga keskel. Riietuseks tumedat tooni rüüzkaunistusega kleit valge mahapööratud krae ja tumepunase ristsõlmes kaelasidemega.
9484.de: Frontal half-length portrait of a young reddish-haired woman. Hairstyle leaving the ears free with a straight parting in the middle. Dressed in a dark-toned dress decorated with a frill, a white turned-down collar and a dark red neck tie in a cross-knot.

9492.d: Esiplaanil mererand muuli ja paatidega, taga kindlus. Taevas kahvatu kuusirp.
9492.de: In the foreground a seashore with a breakwater and boats, behind a fortress. In the sky a pale crescent moon.

9510.d: Keskel seisev Kristuse poolfiguur pöördes vasakule, tema ees tumedanahaline Juudas peaaegu selgvaates. Kristusel pruunid, õlgadele langevad juuksed, parem käsi rinnal, roheline rüü. Juudal tume juus ja habe, punane rüü.
9510.de: In the centre a standing half-figure of Christ turned to the left, before him a dark-skinned Judas seen almost in frontal view. Christ has brown hair falling to his shoulders, right hand on chest, a green robe. Judas has dark hair and beard, a red robe.

9713.d: Noore, tumedajuukselise, vurrudega mehe pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Ümber kaela näha valge kraeääris, altpoolt näha katmata krunti. Taust antud rohekas toonis, ebamääraselt kaarja piirjoonega.
9713.de: Head of a young, dark-haired man with a moustache, in half-profile to the left. A white collar edge visible around the neck, uncovered ground visible from below. Background given in a greenish tone, with a vaguely arched outline.

9752.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaljune rand üksiku kotkaga suurel rahnul, vasemal keskel ja tagaplaanil kaljud, paremal puude vahel hooned, taustaks pilvedesse ulatuvad mäed.
9752.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky shore with a lone eagle on a large boulder, on the left in the middle and background cliffs, on the right buildings among trees, background of mountains reaching into the clouds.

9781.d: Esiplaanil kitsa rohtunud kaldaribaga jõgi punases kuues sõudjatega keset vett asuvas paadis. Tagaplaanil kogu pildi laiust haarav kivist sild. Nelja võlvkaarega sillal üksik naisfiguur, taga paremal mets.
9781.de: In the foreground a river with a narrow grassy strip of bank, with a boat in the middle of the water containing rowers in red coats. In the background a stone bridge spanning the full width of the picture. On the bridge, with four arches, a solitary female figure, a forest behind on the right.

25521.d: Piiblistseen: Jeruusalemma hävitamine. Vasakul ja keskel stseenid meeleheitel inimestega. Vasakul ees põgeneb mees rinda paljastades madudega kättemaksuvaimude eest. Keskel ees pika habemega vanamees, kolm naist sh. üks surnud naine. Vanamees hoiab mõõka käes, tema kõrval varandusehunnik. Paremal ees lahkuvad vagad ja õiglased palmiokstega ning lauldes, neid saadavad kolm eredat valgust heitva lambiga inglit. Paremalt tungivad mahalangenud sammaste vahelt sisse roomlased, kes haaravad naiste ja vara järele. Ratsahobusel istub Rooma keiser Titus, keda saadavad liktorid ja ümbritsevad Rooma võimu sümboliseerivad embleemid. Ülalt lendavad alla kättemaksuinglid põlevate mõõkadega. Kõrgel pilvede
25521.de: Biblical scene: the destruction of Jerusalem. On the left and in the middle scenes with people in despair. In the foreground on the left a man flees baring his chest from spirits of vengeance with snakes. In the middle foreground an old man with a long beard, three women incl. one dead woman. The old man holds a sword in his hand, beside him a pile of treasure. In the foreground on the right the pious and the righteous depart with palm branches, singing, accompanied by three angels casting bright light with lamps. From the right, through fallen columns, the Romans force their way in, seizing the women and the property. On horseback sits the Roman emperor Titus, accompanied by lictors and surrounded by emblems symbolising Roman power. From above avenging angels fly down with burning swords. High among the clouds

57953.de:
Academic drawing after a plaster cast: a male nude hung on a tree.
The model for the plaster sculpture, a Hellenistic sculpture, is in the Louvre in Paris. In the sculpture Marsyas is tied to the tree awaiting flaying. The accompanying figures - a Scythian sharpening a knife and Apollo - are apparently missing.

66371.d: R. Brendamouri graafiline leht teisest üldlaulupeost on varane ja haruldane näide märgiliste Eesti ajaloosündmuste kujutamisest 19. sajandi graafikas ja eriti sajandi keskpaigas populaarseks saanud puugravüüri tehnikas. Leht on Eesti muuseumikogudes harvaesinev ja puudus seni Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogust
66371.de: R. Brendamour's print of the second General Song Festival is an early and rare example of the depiction of significant Estonian historical events in 19th-century printmaking, and especially in the woodcut technique that became popular in the middle of the century. The sheet is rare in Estonian museum collections and was until now missing from the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia
